description: This file defines the RecurrenceInfo class, which manages recurrence rules, exception rules, and date lists for scheduling or calendar functionalities within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initialization, validation, iteration, and conversion to temporal expressions.

classes.name: RecurrenceInfo
classes.description: Manages recurrence rules, exception rules, and date lists for scheduling, providing methods for iteration, validation, and conversion to temporal expressions.

classes.name: RecurrenceWrapper
classes.description: Inner class that wraps RecurrenceInfo to implement the TemporalExpression interface for transition to temporal-based scheduling.

methods.name: RecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes RecurrenceInfo with a GenericValue object, validating entity name and calling init().

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes recurrence rules, exception rules, start date, and date lists from the provided GenericValue.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the recurrence info.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start date as a long timestamp.

methods.name: getRecurrenceRuleIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over recurrence rules.

methods.name: getRecurrenceDateIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over recurrence dates.

methods.name: getExceptionRuleIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over exception recurrence rules.

methods.name: getExceptionDateIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over exception dates.

methods.name: getCurrentCount
methods.description: Returns the current recurrence count.

methods.name: incrementCurrentCount
methods.description: Increments the recurrence count and updates the record.

methods.name: incrementCurrentCount
methods.description: Increments the recurrence count with optional persistence.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the recurrence and associated rules from persistent storage.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the first recurrence (start date).

methods.name: last
methods.description: Placeholder for calculating the last recurrence (not implemented).

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next recurrence from now.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next recurrence from a specified time.

methods.name: isValidCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the current recurrence is valid at the current time.

methods.name: isValidCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the recurrence is valid at a specified time.

methods.name: getNextTime
methods.description: Calculates the next recurrence time based on a rule and fromTime.

methods.name: checkDateList
methods.description: Checks and returns the next valid date from a list of dates.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Determines if a given time is valid considering exception rules and dates.

methods.name: primaryKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key string of the recurrence info.

methods.name: makeInfo
methods.description: Creates a new RecurrenceInfo object with specified parameters.

methods.name: toTemporalExpression
methods.description: Converts a RecurrenceInfo object into a TemporalExpression.
